requirements.text: The atlas compliance baseline shall retain compliance evidence using the compliance evidence service.
The atlas compliance baseline shall report control implementation status to the compliance officer.
The people security and awareness shall record employee screening status in the personnel lifecycle record before privileged access.
The people security and awareness shall record policy acknowledgment for every employee at onboarding.
The people security and awareness shall record annual employee completion in the security awareness training record.
The people security and awareness shall request a line manager access review following an employee role change.
The people security and awareness shall revoke employee access following employment termination.
The people security and awareness shall request people operations partner confirmation of company asset return following employment termination.
